subject: Stability playbook + signal handoff: dashboards, traces, alerts
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Zhou <claire@clearsight.io>
Date: 2025-11-25T17:15:00Z
Subject: Stability playbook: initial signal inventory and goals

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Per our call, I wanted to surface the initial inventory of signals we're concerned about for production launch: client-side latency spikes, model timeouts, KV cache amplification during peak bursts, and a rising 5xx error rate on the inference gateway.

Goals for the engagement:
- Map each signal to a dashboard tile and an "owner" within our SRE org
- Define tracing hooks so we can sample relevant spans for model decode latency
- Agree alert routing and severity (P1/P2/P3) and runbook escalation steps

I've attached an early stability playbook PDF and a CSV of current metric names.

Can we aim to have a concrete owners matrix and dashboard wireframes by Dec 4th? Happy to coordinate the working session.

Thanks,
Samir
Sr. Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Health
Attachments: stability-playbook-v1.pdf, acme-signals.csv

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-26T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Stability playbook: initial signal inventory and goals

Samir — appreciate the clear inventory.

Plan of attack:
1) Owners matrix: Ben will propose owners per signal (SRE, App, Model Ops) by EOD 11/27.
2) Dashboards: Laura and I will sketch dashboard wireframes (overview + per-service tabs) and drop a Drive link by 11/29.
3) Tracing hooks: Soojin will list suggested span attributes (model_id, sequence_len, cache_hit, decode_ms) and a sample instrumentation snippet for your engineers.
4) Alerts & runbooks: We'll propose default severities and a one-page runbook template (linked) for P1/P2.

Request: Can you share the names of the SRE owners you want in the owners matrix and a sample trace/span if available? If not, we'll create a minimal example to iterate.

I'll set up a 60-minute working session for Dec 2nd 10:00–11:00 PT — please confirm attendees.

Thanks,
Marissa
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: alert-runbook-template.md
Related: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cStabilityPlaybook

Marissa + team — quick follow-up on owners & alert routing.

Owner proposal (draft):
- Client latency spikes: App SRE (oncall-app)
- Model timeouts / decode latency: Model Ops (model-ops-team)
- KV cache amplification: Infra SRE (infra-cache)
- Inference gateway 5xx: API SRE (inference-gateway-oncall)

Alert routing suggestion:
- P1 -> PagerDuty -> oncall team -> Marissa (CS) and Ben (SE) cc'd
- P2 -> Slack #acme-alerts -> SRE rotation -> triage in next 4 hrs
- P3 -> Email + ticket to backlog

I'll prepare a short owner CSV and a proposed PagerDuty escalation policy before the Dec 2nd session.

-Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-28T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Stability playbook: initial signal inventory and goals

Quick note on tracing hooks and sampling:

Suggested span attributes to capture at decode boundary:
- redwood.model_id
- redwood.model_variant
- redwood.sequence_length
- redwood.kv_cache_hit (bool)
- redwood.decode_ms (int)
- redwood.request_route

Instrumentation snippet (pseudo):

    span = tracer.start_span("decode")
    span.set_tag("redwood.model_id", model_id)
    span.set_tag("redwood.sequence_length", len(tokens))
    span.set_tag("redwood.kv_cache_hit", cache_hit)
    span.set_metric("redwood.decode_ms", decode_time_ms)
    span.finish()

Sampling: start with 1% global sampling + 100% for any request with decode_ms > 200ms or 5xx responses. If you can send a representative trace sample (zipkin/jaeger), I can make the snippet concrete.

Also: I'll add a small checklist for "trace to dashboard" mapping (span -> metric extraction -> dashboard tile) in the Drive doc.

-Soojin
Head of Observability
Redwood Inference
